snippet.title: Starliners - Official Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo and wishlist Starliners on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5102300/STARLINERS/

Starliners is an incremental space logistics game about building an interplanetary economy. Expand across the Solar System, manage deliveries between planets, build increasingly complex production chains, and gradually automate your logistics as your civilization grows.

Keep your colonies supplied, develop new technologies, and connect distant worlds, all working towards one goal: constructing an enormous generation ship to carry humanity beyond the Solar System.

Press kit:
https://qualiainteractive.com/press/starliners/

#Starliners #IncrementalGames #AutomationGames
